---
title: "nginx"
---

This guide will walk you through setting up atima as a web server.

<code><pre>

http {

  # Start several atima processes with an R command like:
  # sapply(8081:8085, function (port) {
  #   atima::run(config = list(
  #     BIND_HOST = "127.0.0.1",
  #     BIND_PORT = port,
  #     DATA_DIR  = "/data/atima",
  #     TEMP_DIR  = "/tmp/atima"
  #   ))
  # })


  # Load balancer.
  # Prefers server with least connections.
  upstream atima_backend {
    least_conn;
    server 127.0.0.1:8081;
    server 127.0.0.1:8082;
    server 127.0.0.1:8083;
    server 127.0.0.1:8084;
    server 127.0.0.1:8085;
  }


  # Forward HTTP to HTTPS.
	server {
		listen               80;
		server_name          atima.research.bcm.edu;
		client_max_body_size 200M;
		return 302           https://$host$request_uri;
	}


	server {
		listen                443 ssl;
		server_name           atima.research.bcm.edu;
		client_max_body_size  200M;
		access_log            /var/log/nginx/atima.access.log;
		error_log             /var/log/nginx/atima.error.log error;

		ssl_certificate       /etc/ssl/selfsigned/atima.crt;
		ssl_certificate_key   /etc/ssl/selfsigned/atima.key;


    # Pass this request to one of the atima backend processes.
		location / {
      proxy_pass http://atima_backend;

      client_max_body_size 200M;

      proxy_http_version 1.1;
      proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
      proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
      proxy_read_timeout 600s;

      proxy_redirect    off;
      proxy_set_header  Host              $http_host;
      proxy_set_header  X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
      proxy_set_header  X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
      proxy_set_header  X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
		}


    # Optional:
    # Bypass atima's R processes when serving static assets.

    # Comment out below lines if not configured.

    # Atima's javascript, css, etc installation path.
    # R command to tell you the correct directory:
    # system.file(package = "atima", "www", "static")
    location /static/ {
      root /lib64/R/library/atima/www/static;
    }

    # config$FILES_DIR, or {config$DATA_DIR}/files
    # BIOM files are saved here long term.
    location /files/ {
      root /data/atima/files;
    }
    
    # config$TEMP_DIR
    # Figures are written here and the URL sent to the client
    location /tmp/ {
      root /tmp/atima;
    }

	}
}

</pre><code>
